query: For my 57-year-old female patient: among women 52–62 admitted with AMI whose first Troponin T >0.01 ng/mL, report patient/admission counts, mean age, LOS, first troponin stats, and in-hospital mortality.
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS admission_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' * p.anchor_year)) AS average_age, AVG(a.los) AS average_length_of_stay, MIN(l.value) AS min_troponin_concentration, MAX(l.value) AS max_troponin_concentration, SUM(CASE WHEN d.deathtime IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS death_count FROM patients p JOIN admissions a ON p.subject_id = a.subject_id JOIN labevents l ON a.hadm_id = l.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = l.hadm_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id AND a.hadm_id = d.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.dob) = 1957 AND l.itemid = 83984 AND l.value > 0.01 AND d.icd_code = '410' AND d.icd_version = '4' AND a.admission_type = 'AMI' GROUP BY p.subject_id, a.hadm_id;
